one_line: A lead builder overseeing the construction of Mandu’s Jami Masjid and Ashrafi Mahal in the 15th-century Ghuri–Khalji era.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s, wiry but strong, with the steady build of an experienced craftsman.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium brown Malwa complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, a few fine worry lines at the brow; default expression focused and calm, with sharp, observant eyes.
appearance.hair: Black hair, straight and kept short under a simple white cotton skullcap (taqiyah), with a narrow dark red cloth band wrapped once around its base like a headband.
appearance.costume: Long knee-length off‑white cotton kurta with a straight collar and side slits, worn over a deep indigo cotton salwar slightly gathered at the ankles; a light sandy‑beige cotton shawl draped over both shoulders and crossing the chest, ends hanging to mid‑thigh; simple brown leather belt at the waist holding small pouches; plain brown leather sandals; subtle evidence of work—minor chalk marks and stone dust at hem and cuffs—but overall neat and dignified.
appearance.signature: A long wooden measuring staff marked with carved divisions, held in one hand, with a rolled palm‑leaf plan tube tucked at his belt.

ref_desc: A focused medium-brown Mandu master mason in off-white kurta, deep indigo salwar, sandy-beige shawl, white skullcap with dark red band, brown belt and sandals, always carrying a carved wooden measuring staff and palm-leaf plans in a brown tube, using off-white, indigo, beige, dark red and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style historical character: a late-30s Mandu master mason with an oval, medium-brown Malwa face, neat short black hair under a white cotton skullcap encircled by a dark red band, and a trimmed beard, his expression focused and calm. He wears a knee-length off-white cotton kurta with side slits over deep indigo salwar gathered at the ankles, a sandy-beige shawl draped over both shoulders and crossing the chest with the ends hanging to mid-thigh, a simple brown leather belt with small pouches, and plain brown leather sandals; his garments are neat with faint stone dust and chalk marks at edges. In his dominant hand he holds a long carved wooden measuring staff marked with divisions, and at his belt is a brown tube for rolled palm-leaf plans. Use off-white, deep indigo, sandy beige, dark red and brown as the main colours, and show him clearly from head to toe in a neutral pose suitable for a model sheet.
